title: Miso Baron - First Meeting

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Yeah yeah yeah, I got your stuff, you wanna draw some more attention over here? The Neon got ears, pal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah yeah yeah, I got your stuff, you wanna draw some more attention over here? The Neon got ears, pal.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: The Miso Baron doesn't have time for this. Took a lot to get this much Brown on short notice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Miso Baron doesn't have time for this. Took a lot to get this much Brown on short notice.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Eyes too, lots of eyes. Eyes that see through the smog, you feel. Probably see through you too. You're practically glass. Now, take the Brown and get lost.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eyes too, lots of eyes. Eyes that see through the smog, you feel. Probably see through you too. You're practically glass. Now, take the Brown and get lost.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Oh, come on. Brown? Paste? Moon Glue? Putty? PutPut?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, come on. Brown? Paste? Moon Glue? Putty? PutPut?

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Pulp? Umami? Beige? Clag? Meaty MudMud, Ramen fuel?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pulp? Umami? Beige? Clag? Meaty MudMud, Ramen fuel?

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Woah, woah, woah! You had better put your blower into low-power-mode amigo. Since CorpSec classified Paste as an S-Class super substance, we'd both be looking at twenty years in a scum-pit for even having this convo!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Woah, woah, woah! You had better put your blower into low-power-mode amigo. Since CorpSec classified Paste as an S-Class super substance, we'd both be looking at twenty years in a scum-pit for even having this convo!

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Hold up, The Miso Baron is getting a funny feeling that you aren't my buyer?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hold up, The Miso Baron is getting a funny feeling that you aren't my buyer?

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Now that I think of it, the buyer did describe themselves as a "formidable presence, feared by both kings and paupers alike" and you are not like that. Not at all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now that I think of it, the buyer did describe themselves as a "formidable presence, feared by both kings and paupers alike" and you are not like that. Not at all.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Look, you need to forget we had this convo amigo. I was never here. I'm a ghost, I'm liquid on the lake, I'm an oubliette inside an oubliette. Unless of course...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, you need to forget we had this convo amigo. I was never here. I'm a ghost, I'm liquid on the lake, I'm an oubliette inside an oubliette. Unless of course...

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Sure man, I mean if you think you can get better Clag elsewhere, you go right ahead. Go see what those wet-dogs are peddling down at the docks. A little gut rot never hurt anyone right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure man, I mean if you think you can get better Clag elsewhere, you go right ahead. Go see what those wet-dogs are peddling down at the docks. A little gut rot never hurt anyone right?

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Yeah, I knew you were on the level. I could feel it. Look, you hit me up here whenever you need some of the salty good stuff. I'll do you a good price, a friend price.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, I knew you were on the level. I could feel it. Look, you hit me up here whenever you need some of the salty good stuff. I'll do you a good price, a friend price.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: I mean who does? Look, you hit me up when you want a taste of the salty good stuff, and I'll do you a good price, a friend price.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean who does? Look, you hit me up when you want a taste of the salty good stuff, and I'll do you a good price, a friend price.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Barely, and even if it was, at my special friend prices, it would be really silly to pass up on an opportunity like this!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Barely, and even if it was, at my special friend prices, it would be really silly to pass up on an opportunity like this!

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: You know my real name. I'm The Miso Baron.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know my real name. I'm The Miso Baron.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: That is my real name. CorpSec forced me to take one of those damn CBI procedures last year and it scrubbed all my memories up to that point.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That is my real name. CorpSec forced me to take one of those damn CBI procedures last year and it scrubbed all my memories up to that point.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Criminal Behavioural Implants. Some white-coat at CorpSec HQ thought it would be a good idea to inject happy-go-lucky-fucky memories into criminals to persuade them not to re-offend. Turns out one slip of the thumb and you lose everything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Criminal Behavioural Implants. Some white-coat at CorpSec HQ thought it would be a good idea to inject happy-go-lucky-fucky memories into criminals to persuade them not to re-offend. Turns out one slip of the thumb and you lose everything.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: That's what it said on my report sheet before I hightailed it out of the facility. Thought it would be a nice little fuck-you to the suits.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's what it said on my report sheet before I hightailed it out of the facility. Thought it would be a nice little fuck-you to the suits.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Yeah strange, normally CorpSec treat us street-levels with the utmost respect...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah strange, normally CorpSec treat us street-levels with the utmost respect...

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Maybe, maybe not. Anyway, come back sometime for a free sample. You know where I am.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe, maybe not. Anyway, come back sometime for a free sample. You know where I am.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: I knew you were on the level amigo. Anyway, come back sometime for a free sample. You know where I am.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I knew you were on the level amigo. Anyway, come back sometime for a free sample. You know where I am.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Turns out, they fucked with me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Turns out, they fucked with me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sorry, what stuff?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry, what stuff?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you mean? Ears?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you mean? Ears?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Brown? What are you talking about?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Brown? What are you talking about?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Brown? What are you talking about?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Brown? What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nope...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nope...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you talking about Miso?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you talking about Miso?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why shouldn't I report you then?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why shouldn't I report you then?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why shouldn't I report you then?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why shouldn't I report you then?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll keep my mouth shut.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll keep my mouth shut.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm definitely not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, I'm definitely not.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I could be.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I could be.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not interested.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not interested.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm listening.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm listening.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Friends? I don't even know your real name.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Friends? I don't even know your real name.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Friends? I don't even know your real name.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Friends? I don't even know your real name.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't like the sound of "gut rot"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't like the sound of "gut rot"
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't like the sound of "gut rot"
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't like the sound of "gut rot"

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I thought it was illegal?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I thought it was illegal?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, your real name.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, your real name.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's a CBI procedure?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's a CBI procedure?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You could have chosen any new identity. Why choose the name 'Miso Baron'?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You could have chosen any new identity. Why choose the name 'Miso Baron'?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You could have chosen any new identity. Why choose the name 'Miso Baron'?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You could have chosen any new identity. Why choose the name 'Miso Baron'?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That doesn't sound very ethical.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That doesn't sound very ethical.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah I like that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah I like that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Should have gone for something more sensible.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Should have gone for something more sensible.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Should have gone for something more sensible.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Should have gone for something more sensible.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I mean, sure...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean, sure...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Read about it. Implants, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Read about it. Implants, right?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fuck the corps.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuck the corps.
